title_zh: 为作家工作坊准备具体提问

scenario.label_zh: 拟定关于小说创作过程的问题
scenario.goal_zh: 将宽泛的灵感问题改为关于人物与情节修改的具体问题，并确认提问者

context_zh: 写作课学员哈娜与奥马尔准备在一场作家工作坊上提问。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: The novelist visiting our class has offered to answer questions about her first book.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I'd like to ask where she gets her ideas, but she'll probably hear that all evening.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: What interests me is the making of the novel, especially the chapters she decided to cut.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: We could ask whether cutting a chapter changed how she understood the main character.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: That's better. It could start a lively discussion rather than produce a one-word answer.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: And we don't need to use complicated literary terms to ask it.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: I'll ask about the deleted chapter. Could you follow up about whether she changed the ending too?

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Yes. I'll write both questions down so we don't repeat each other.

targets.sense_zh: 文学的；与文学作品有关的
